scenario.name: Pedestrian on or stepping onto a marked crosswalk
scenario.description: The vehicle approaches a marked crosswalk in lane while a pedestrian is on it or steps onto it

events.description: Does not slow down for a pedestrian on the crosswalk
Does not yield to a pedestrian on the crosswalk

triggers.condition: Night or unlit streets, with road users in dark clothing
Light rain, spray thrown up by other vehicles, reflections from the wet road
People of unusual shape or posture (wheelchairs, children, people carrying large objects or pushing strollers)

goals.statement: Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids
Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or crosswalk against right of way

scenario.pass: No contact with the pedestrian; the vehicle yields as the traffic rules require, and the monitor commands the deceleration that restores the safe distance whenever Autoware does not; unjustified hard braking counts against the SOTIF acceptance criteria

parameters.label: ODD-20 Ego speed: 47.9 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)
ODD-03 Posted speed limit: 30 mph (the stated bound)

parameters.parameter: Pedestrian walking speed and start time
parameters.range: Bound stated by FSR-06.01, not yet fixed
parameters.label: Pedestrian walking speed and start time: Bound stated by FSR-06.01, not yet fixed; the motion drawn is choreography

condition_label: ODD-12 day · ODD-13 wet · ODD-10 0.6 mm/h

legend.plan: Autoware's planned path (EL-01 Autoware computer, rated QM)
legend.envelope: Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
legend.meant: Meant to do: yields before the crosswalk
legend.meant_mark: Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle; green ring: where it is judged
legend.hazard: Where the hazard lies: HE-02.1 Does not slow down for a pedestrian on the crosswalk; HE-06.4 Does not yield to a pedestrian on the crosswalk
legend.key: Amber, ringed: the road user the scenario is about

ego.motion_label: Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033); choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
